_about: GAMES 1977-79's text step runs: which one is current (the batch page opens on it, the import reads it) and what each is. A run made to try one fix is a trial until its branch merges and a combined run replaces the current one.

run4.what: the first full text step on v2 (before assembly linked all text)

run6.what: the text step re-run on the 65 puzzles whose printed lines changed with xword-ocr#18

run7.what: run6 rebuilt compute only: keys from a page's other scan, triage fixes; all text step answers reused

run8.what: run7 + two-page clue lists and numbering (session two-page-lists); text step re-run on 18 puzzles

run8b.what: run8 + a continued list's short start (1979-05 L042's Down 1-2 from leaf 40) (xword-ocr claude/dazzling-shannon-d75e00); 75 answers reused from run8, L042 needs the text step

run9.what: overwritten at 17:07 by run8b's build (since moved to textstep/run8b-7779; textstep/run9-7779 no longer exists); proof/run9 and triage/run9 are the earlier run9's; not the clue-reading trial

run9-reading.what: run7 + clue reading after a blank and on second lines, sheets crop the clues worth a look (xword-ocr claude/festive-mestorf-01debb); 30 puzzles need the text step

run10.what: run7 + key letters re-read (letters.glyph_crop: strokes on a key's edge row and stems joined to a heavy border no longer erased as rules; all 303 answer grids re-read); triage checks a key-misread verdict's named answers; all answers reused from run6 (branch claude/key-last-row)

run11.what: the combined run: run7 + all four fixes merged (keys re-read, two-page lists, a continued list's short start, clue reading after blanks; xword-ocr claude/cranky-cannon-3ebcdb d0e9ee0). 47 answers reused from run8, the text step on 30 (xword-text, about 261k Fable tokens). Triage: 10 looks ready, 46 glance, 20 needs attention, 1 more dropped (1979-05 L039, a Line-ups game sheet). Every packet records its region boxes and key outline.

run12-lineend.what: run11 + fill-in blanks at a clue line's end and before a comma put back from the page image (xword-ocr#29, claude/line-end-blank). Text step on 29 puzzles (xword-text, about 260k Fable tokens); the rest reused from run11. Triage: 13 looks ready, 45 glance, 18 needs attention (76 puzzles; the 5 drops stand). Proof packets include the answer key's page.

run13-easy.what: run12-lineend + a second clue set as xd clue metadata (A1 ^Easy: ...), named by its printed heading; the two-clue-sets flag only for a real second set, 28 -> 11 puzzles, the 11 Ornery (xword-ocr claude/clever-agnesi-3f1b16, blitz claude/easy-clue-meta). Compute only: 65 answers reused from run12; the 11 Ornery carry run12's answers (Hard clues corrected), their ^Easy lines as OCR'd until the text step runs on them (textstep/run13-easy/interim.json). 1979-03 L040b's second set is ^Alt: no printed heading names it. Triage as run12: 13 ship, 45 glance, 18 needs attention.

run14-feature.what: run13-easy + a Feature header (a sub-series: The World's Most Ornery Crossword Puzzle, Warmup Puzzle, Crossword a l'Anglaise, Illustrated Crossword) with its printed line as evidence, on the proof and batch pages; kept in the working xd as our own Feature header, the gxd header decided at export. Assembly links each clue set's heading and a list read twice's page text. Text step on the 11 Ornery (xword-text, 3 agents, about 247k Fable tokens), their ^Easy lines and Feature lines included; 65 answers reused from run13-easy. Feature on 17 puzzles, 9 of 11 Ornery (1977's print no Ornery name). Triage: 13 ship, 43 glance, 20 needs attention (1978-07 L040: 6 unsure; 1979-11 L072: key letters flagged misread, asks for the title's page).

run15-restart.what: run14-feature, made restartable from review (xword-ocr claude/nervous-wiles-d685a2): three dispositions (not ready / ready / reviewed), each not-ready puzzle naming its missing part and the stage to restart from; the text step's findings as records (4 old verdicts converted, no model); the restart loop (1978-01 L030b sent back to parts: leaf 30 read with its recorded boxes, its Down list found, then the text step on it alone: about 24k Fable tokens; now ready). 22 not ready, 52 ready, 2 reviewed. Details: the shared notes, restartable-review.md.
